meta.name: update-skill
meta.description: Thorough on-demand refresh of one skill in a skills repository: researches usage/upstream/docs in parallel, gates twice for approval, bumps version, updates CHANGELOG, runs the repo's validation, then commits and watches CI. Install the pond MCP (https://pond.cascade.fyi/) for the prior-session usage angle; without it that angle is skipped. Use to update, refresh, or check the freshness of a specific skill.
